'''''Thor''''' was a [[container transport]] used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The transport was present deploying [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] ''[[Thoret]]'' to ferry [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to stationary [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]].
